blocks.text: MEN ARE WORKING on a sound weapon and say it works! This reminds us in another way, Jesus said in Rev. Chapter 10: 7, “But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as he hath declared to his servants the prophets.”

SCIENCE is feverishly working on weather control and lightning as a weapon for destruction. Evidently as the age closes they do this very thing. Ezekiel 38: 9, “Thou shalt ascend and come like a storm, thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land, thou, and all thy bands, and many people with thee.”

We see also in one chapter hail will fall at 100 pounds (Rev. 16:21). — “And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great!" Everything goes radical. I foresee men are also working on a magnetic shield as to protect them from falling bombs. But there will be no way of escape. — Rev. 18: 8-10. Matt. 24: 22, “And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened.” He intervenes in atomic war.

ALL TYPE OF ROBOTIC GADGETS and _ robotic weapons and tools for every facet of life is being invented and for weapons and robotic armies. But thank God, Jesus is our perfect shield and will sweep us up to Him!

IN THIS DECADE unexpected changes in the way society’s life patterns, people’s lives have been and will totally change and are manipulated. — Already they believe evil is good and good is evil. Thank the Lord for revealing the truth to His children! — They’re going to create technology that works like magic and illusions like the real thing. Also the Lord somewhere in there, the power of the heavens will be shaken by some event or by His own hand.

THE MORE SCIENCE INVENTS coping with diseases the more disease and viruses will come. They’re working on new things for space. Also man will try to control the weather patterns, lightning and the very elements. All of this will backfire at a later point. Also in the decade from 2009 to 2011 it will set up a whole new cycle and quadruple, hurling the world into a total different society. The Bible, Scripts and the celestial are confirming these awesome wonders of God that are right ahead. We surely are entering the midnight hour! This is the time to stand upon your tower and watch. Although it may tarry it will come! It will be like a rushing flood, astonishing and even to some unbelievable things that will occur of what people will do. I have much on this that will be released either on another letter or scroll. Whatever you do don’t miss it!

WHY DO THE RIGHTEOUS and the prophets suffer? — It rains on the just and the unjust alike. Matt. 5: 45, “That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven; for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.” — But God is with His children through their trials! The unrighteous have nothing to help them. The righteous is proven as pure gold as tried in the fire. — Rev. 3: 18, “I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eye salve, that thou mayest see.” — He is the Almighty
The following was written over 20 years ago.

THE ELECT are changing into a new dimension of faith as we near His return! — Here is a beautiful Scripture for you fulfilling itself now and will manifest strongly in the days ahead! — IT Cor. 3: 18, “But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the spirit of the Lord!” — Also the church is entering the spiritual veil of the manifold wisdom of God! A cloud of translative power! — All promises will be fulfilled. — I} Cor. 1: 20-24, “For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him amen, unto the glory of God by us! — Who has also sealed us by His spirit!” — Paul goes on to say, “for by faith ye stand! “The spirit of God moveth upon all things, but only as He is called upon and as thy faith is, so be it unto thee!” — “Behold saith the Lord, I am always present with you. I neither cometh or goeth. To be exact I am your comforter and always at hand and never at a distance! — Yea, even as the wind bloweth you cannot see it but you know that it is there, yea IT am always with you but you must know this by faith and trust! — Not a one of my promises will fail them that rely upon me! TI have upon my fingertips whatsoever My people needeth! — Yea, all things are possible to him that believeth and acteth! — “Behold saith the Lord, be sure and study the writings that you receive in the days ahead!” — This started off as a personal message to you, but then the Holy Spirit began to speak and I gave Him full reign to enlighten you! End quote.

Just like the Scriptures say, the people’s minds are on the chaotic events and also occurrences, that like “in an hour ye think not” He would catch them off guard. So you can definitely see this is the hour of the watchman! We’ll be releasing things for you. Be expecting it. The world is in its worst conditions since thousands of years. The earth has seen nothing yet. Surely He is watching over His children in such
